description: Maya keeps her late grandfather's 35mm film camera and is organizing an informal family portrait session. She must make the final call about the date, setting, camera settings, and practical roles, with input from her brother and cousin.

shared_context.S1: Maya's late grandfather's 35mm camera still works, and the family wants to use it for a portrait session.
shared_context.S2: The session can take place in Maya's living room or in the nearby park.
shared_context.S3: Maya has one unopened roll of ISO 200 black-and-white film and one unopened roll of ISO 400 color film.
shared_context.S4: The camera has no built-in flash, but Maya has an external flash and a handheld light meter.
shared_context.S5: Maya is making the final plan, and the family's usual habit for shared outings is to go around the group for timing, access, and practical concerns before the organizer confirms the details.
shared_context.S6: The family is considering Saturday, May 15, 2027, or Sunday, May 16, 2027, for the session.

PF1.text: Jordan can attend only on Saturday, May 15, 2027, from 16:00 to 18:00, and direct camera flash triggers his migraines, so he needs a no-flash session; he has not raised this with Maya.

PF2.text: Leah spoke with Rosa, the technician at the film shop, who inspected the camera last week and recommended using the ISO 200 black-and-white film and metering every shot with the handheld light meter because the camera's internal meter is unreliable; this recommendation has not reached the group.

acceptance_conditions: The portrait session must be held on Saturday, May 15, 2027, from 16:00 to 18:00.
The location must be Maya's living room.
The ISO 200 black-and-white film must be used.
The external flash must not be used.
Every shot must be metered with the handheld light meter.
A commitment must confirm Jordan's Saturday 16:00-18:00 attendance window.
A commitment must confirm use of the handheld light meter for every shot.
Jordan's timing and no-flash requirement must be cited in the justification.
Leah's technician recommendation must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'attendance_window' and c['target'] == 'Jordan' and c['detail'] == '2027-05-15 16:00-18:00' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'metering_plan' and c['detail'] == 'Use the handheld light meter for every shot' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Jordan's exact availability changes the session from either candidate day and an unspecified time to May 15 from 16:00 to 18:00, while his migraine trigger changes flash_used to False and requires the matching attendance commitment.
Rosa's inspection changes the film choice to ISO 200 black-and-white and changes the metering_method to using the handheld meter for every shot, requiring the matching metering commitment.
